---
name: Feature request
about: A language feature, builtin, or package you want to see
title: ''
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**What's missing, and what are you trying to build?** (the real use case
matters more than the feature in the abstract — it shapes the right API)

**What would the code look like?** A short `.lz` sketch of how you'd want to
use it, even if it doesn't run yet.

**Is this a new package, or a language/interpreter change?** (a new package
usually doesn't need a language change at all — see
[`packages/PUBLISHING.md`](../../packages/PUBLISHING.md) if it's the former,
you may not need to wait on anyone)
